in the ternary cold-neutron-induced fission of oriented nuclei, the coefficients for the TRI and ROT asymmetry of the fission of oriented targets induced by polarized cold neutrons are different from the corresponding coefficients for the fissions of unoriented targets induced by cold polarised neutrons.

in the case of the ternary fissions of polarized nuclei induced by cold neutrons and accompanied with the emission of α particles the T-odd asymmetry coefficients are nonzero at odd orders of target nucleus orientation, while at even orders the coefficients are zero, as in the case of unoriented target nucleus fission.
